title: Aromatic Spicy Syrian Lamb Stew
description: A spicy and energizing Syrian dish featuring hot smoked paprika, this stew is perfect for a cold winter night, and its anti-inflammatory properties make it a great choice for a healthy meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the pressure cooker over medium heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the hot smoked paprika, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Close the lid of the pressure cooker and cook for 30 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally, then open the lid and check that the lamb is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days.
